# palletface

> ESM library for deterministic SVG avatars in Node and browsers. Install `palletface` from npm. The standalone browser global is `DitherFace`.

## Documentation

- [Integration guide](./docs/guide.md): Installation, `ditherFace` options, style slugs, browser and server examples, and output guarantees.
- [Source](https://github.com/puri-adityakumar/palletface): Library implementation and package version.
